arms.description: Participants will receive orforglipron orally + standard of care
arms.label: Orforglipron

arms.description: Participants will receive placebo orally + standard of care
arms.label: Placebo

eligibility.criteria_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Have established ASCVD and/or CKD

Exclusion Criteria:

* Have type 1 diabetes
* Have had a major heart condition within 60 days prior to screening
* Have New York Heart Association Functional Classification Class IV heart failure

outcomes.description: Composite endpoint includes nonfatal myocardial infarction, nonfatal stroke, hospitalization or urgent visit due to heart failure, coronary revascularization, or all-cause death
outcomes.measure: Time to First Occurrence of Composite Endpoint of Major Cardiovascular Events
outcomes.time_frame: Baseline up to end of study (about 5 years)

outcomes.description: Composite endpoint includes nonfatal myocardial infarction, nonfatal stroke, hospitalization or urgent visit due to heart failure, coronary revascularization, ≥40% sustained decline in estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR), end-stage kidney disease, or all-cause death
outcomes.measure: Time to First Occurrence of Composite Endpoint of Major Cardiovascular and Kidney Events
outcomes.time_frame: Baseline up to end of study (about 5 years)

outcomes.measure: Change from Baseline in Total eGFR Slope
outcomes.time_frame: Baseline up to end of study (about 5 years)

outcomes.measure: Time to Onset of Type 2 Diabetes
outcomes.time_frame: Baseline up to end of study (about 5 years)

trial.brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to measure cardiovascular outcomes with orforglipron compared with placebo in participants with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) and/or chronic kidney disease (CKD). Participation in the study will last about 5 years.
trial.brief_title: A Study of Orforglipron (LY3502970) on Cardiovascular Outcomes in Adults With Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease and/or Chronic Kidney Disease (ATTAIN-Outcomes)
trial.criteria_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Have established ASCVD and/or CKD

Exclusion Criteria:

* Have type 1 diabetes
* Have had a major heart condition within 60 days prior to screening
* Have New York Heart Association Functional Classification Class IV heart failure
trial.official_title: A Phase 3, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Event-Driven Study to Investigate the Effect of Orforglipron on the Incidence of Major Adverse Cardiovascular Events in Participants With Established Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease and/or Chronic Kidney Disease
